title: Domain, range and composite functions
intro: Read this before the questions on domain, range and composition.

blocks.title: domain and range
blocks.body: The **domain** is the set of allowed inputs $x$. The **range** is the set of outputs $y$ that actually occur.

blocks.title: the slips
items: Square roots need $\ge0$, but logs and denominators need strict conditions.
$f(g(x))$ means $g$ goes **first**, even though $f$ is written first.
